John Acme (acme): Hey @support — our production org `acme-prod-1234` just hit 0 monthly credits mid-request. Streaming calls started returning 429s around 2025-09-02T21:58:30Z. UI initially showed ~1.2k tokens then jumped to 0 after a page refresh. This happened during the rolling backend migration. Can you check if a refill job was skipped?
Ana (support): Sorry you're hitting this, John. Can you paste an example request_id or a raw 429 response (headers) if available? Also which SDK / api key did you use?
John Acme (acme): request_id: `req_0a2b3c4d`, api key prefix `rk_acm...` Using server-side REST from our infra host. We saw 429 with body: `{\"error\":\"quota_exhausted\"}`.
DeployBot: Rolling migration step started for service `quota-refill-scheduler` at 2025-09-02T21:55:10Z. CI job id: `deploy-2025-09-02-855`.
Ana (support): Thanks. I'm escalating to infra — @elaine can you look for refill job runs for `acme-prod-1234` between 21:50 and 22:05Z and check for errors?
Elaine (infra): Looking now. I can see the scheduler attempted a refill at 21:55:15Z but worker logs show a transient DB conn error and a retry was scheduled. There's a follow-up log showing a lock conflict and the tenant refill was skipped after 3 retries. Snippet: ```
ERROR quota_refill_worker - tenant: acme-prod-1234 - sql: deadlock detected - retry=3
WARN quota_refill_worker - giving up tenant=acme-prod-1234 after retries
```
Sam (eng-runtime): That aligns with the longpoll reconnects — the token cache on edge was stale and returned 0 until TTL expired. We had a migration that changed the refill lock table schema; the worker pool rollback left one node with old schema, causing deadlocks under contention.
John Acme (acme): Ok — is there a manual fix for customers who saw this? We had a live demo running and it cut out.
Elaine (infra): Manual fix: we re-enqueued the missing refill job for the tenant and triggered an immediate top-up. I ran: ```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN\" https://infra.internal/api/refill -d '{\"tenant\":\"acme-prod-1234\",\"force\":true}'
``` Response: `{\"status\":\"ok\",\"refilled\":120000}`. Took effect ~30s after enqueue.
Marta (billing): Billing note: because the refill ran late we pro-rated the visible monthly bucket and added a support credit of 5k tokens to compensate for customer impact. I'll follow up with an invoice note.
Ana (support): John — can you confirm your service recovered after ~22:00Z? Any lingering 429s for the same request_id?
John Acme (acme): Service recovered, resumed at ~22:01:10Z. We did see a few retry 429s for in-flight longpolls but reconnects succeeded. Thanks for the fast action.
Sam (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) revert migration plan to ensure schema compatibility checks run earlier, 2) add tenant-level backstop so a tenant doesn't get skipped if workers error, 3) add alert when refill job fails >2 tenants in <5m.
Elaine (infra): Agreed. I'll open an infra ticket with repro steps and the failing node id. Repro steps (internal): ```
1) Deploy mixed-schema refill worker (v1 + v2) to pool.
2) Create high-concurrency refill window for tenants A,B,C.
3) Force a DB lock by running competing DDL on lock table.
4) Observe worker retry and skip behavior.
```
Ana (support): Adding support doc blurb for customers hit by mid-cycle refill skips and the manual ops workaround. Will tag you on the doc, @sam. :thumbsup:
John Acme (acme): Appreciate the triage and the token credit. Can you add us to the postmortem thread when available?
Elaine (infra): Will do. Following PM: `infra-5432` -> postmortem link will be shared in #postmortems.
DeployBot: Deploy `quota-refill-worker` rollback completed at 2025-09-02T22:10:05Z.
Ana (support): Closing this support thread — reopened if you see anything else. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
